searchEvidence: Reuse gate: scripts/verify.py already owns handle-relative test-root, sessions-root, session and marker creation plus exact-identity cleanup through _create_windows_relative_path, _require_windows_cleanup_handle and TestSessionCustody; the correction must extend those owners and must not add a second temp-root, custody or deletion framework.

Exact PR run 33446084709 built successfully but the three Windows test shards failed under the new sessionized TEMP. Bootstrap reported an explicit supported-Windows-path-length failure and recovery Busy, UI failed after the same AB bundle run error, and Infrastructure reported 200 launcher/recovery custody failures dominated by Unavailable, Busy and RecoveryRequired.

The frozen local verifier at 862785994f36329082e732ff37ede37344ad965a passed structure in 530.9 seconds but its Python lane produced 81 FileNotFound errors under D:/NvtFwCombiner-TestArea/sessions/session-<32-hex>/temp where canonical Golden and parity fixtures crossed the Windows path limit; this is independent reproduction of the CI path-budget defect.

_create_windows_relative_path currently grants DELETE to every created directory while retaining a handle that denies FILE_SHARE_DELETE. Existing product WindowsStablePathCustody opens each ancestor without FILE_SHARE_DELETE, so the retained verifier handle and the product custody handle are mutually incompatible even though both paths are individually correct.

Measured failing full paths were 262 characters for the Bootstrap AB bundle, 265 for its UI staging projection, 264 for the local canonical-Golden fixture, and 265 for the local parity preview; the existing product limit is 259. Replacing the 40-character session- plus 32-lowercase-hex name with a 28-character s- plus 26-lowercase-unpadded-Base32 name and temp with t saves 15 characters, reducing the observed maximum to 250 and leaving nine characters of margin.

Lowercase unpadded Base32 of exactly secrets.token_bytes(16) is case-fold stable on Windows and reversibly represents all 128 input bits; unlike mixed-case Base64url, it preserves the full 2^128 filename namespace while reusing the existing standard library, exclusive-create retry and marker identity contract.

terminalContract: Keep the exact local NFC_TEST_AREA_ROOT and GitHub RUNNER_TEMP-derived root contracts, one sessions parent, one exclusive marker-bound session, all scratch descendants, environment restoration, and exact identity/reparse cleanup unchanged. On ordinary workload exit, before marker deletion, cleanup closes the retained session custody handle and reacquires the existing delete-capable handle through _require_windows_cleanup_handle with the exact recorded identity and non-reparse checks; provisional setup-failure cleanup must perform the same close-and-exact-reacquire transition before deleting either marker or session. Together these reuse the existing secrets, exclusive-create, marker and scratch-map owners, save 15 characters, and reduce the measured 265-character canonical maximum to 250 against the existing 259-character limit without changing the fixed root or allowing writes outside the owned session. Add focused regression evidence for compatible nested custody, retained anti-replacement behavior, ordinary and provisional exact cleanup, the exact 128-bit name shape, and creation of the previously failing canonical/parity path projections. Do not change product WindowsStablePathCustody, firmware, package contents, Golden selection, Catalog, release permission, output bytes, broad cleanup scope, stale-session handling or final evidence paths.
